subject: Insert text or selection in the textbox at the currently cursor position by using updateTextinput()

messages.author: 6411ee26bdcb885c
messages.subject: Insert text or selection in the textbox at the currently cursor position by using updateTextinput()
parts:
Hello everybody!

I am new with Shiny and i want to write an app that includes a textbox and a dropdown menu (textInput() and selectInput())

My idea is to type a textstring and to insert the selection of the dropdown menu at the currently cursor position an after that maybe i want to continue with typing (like below).

Description (it should be):

    I type "helloBerlin" and set the cursor in the middle of the string:

    --> helloCURSORBerlin

    and when i select FRANKFURT in the drop down menu than it should be:

    --> helloFRANKFURTBerlin             --> That would be great

 

My PROBLEM:

    My problem is that the cursor jumps to the end of the string when i was selecting something (Berlin, Hamburg, etc) in the drop down menu (selectInput) like this:
    helloBerlinFRANKFURT

    I don't want it like this!! ;-(

    I know that i am using this usage in the code, because i want the input value of input1 and input2! to bring them together as a string, therefore paste(y,x) :
    updateTextInput(session, "input2", value = paste(y,x))

    the argument "paste(y,x)" obove is probably the problem but i dont know how i use it correctly

    I am using isolate() so that the text box (inputText) will not be flooded (loop)!

    Please, i need help!!

    Thanks a lot,
     regards.

Script:
    ---------server.R:

    shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {
    observe({
    x <- input$input1
    y <- isolate(input$input2)
    updateTextInput(session, "input2", value = paste(y,x))
    updateTextInput(session, "input1", value = paste("", sep="", c("Stadt:"="", "Berlin",
    "Hamburg", "Frankfurt")))
    })
    })

    ----------ui.R:

    shinyUI(fluidPage(
    selectInput('input1', label = NULL, c("Stadt:"="", "Berlin",
    "Hamburg", "Frankfurt",selectize=FALSE),
    textInput("input2", "", value = "")
    ))
